verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents programmatic management of the full card lifecycle through its API, from issuing to activation to deactivation, including virtual card issuance. It also documents debit cards for authorized users on existing accounts, a card fulfillment flow with `card.create` webhooks, suspension of cards, and ATM access. For spend controls, the Card Auth Loop endpoint lets a developer accept or reject transactions in real time, but the rules are business logic you write yourself rather than built-in limits. missing for 10: any evidence of digital wallet (Apple Pay/Google Pay) provisioning, explicit documentation of physical card issuance beyond the fulfillment flow, built-in configurable spend limits or merchant controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
